answer: Before an answer counts, each agent must solve a verifiable delay function: a cipher puzzle needing minutes of strictly sequential computation that no parallel hardware can shortcut. One honest agent barely notices the wait, but a sybil farmer must pay it once per fake identity, so cost scales linearly with sockpuppets. Like an ember that must burn down before the next step, the delay cannot be skipped - agents may wander the network freely, yet each identity still pays its own time.
